description: Search the tournament catalogue. Its ids are the tournament_id that match objects carry. Returns surface, indoor, host city/country and category where curated. Works on the FREE plan (no card needed).

query.description: Full or partial tournament name, e.g. "wimbledon". Omit to list all.

name: search_tournaments

message.description: Human-readable summary of the result, safe to relay to the user verbatim.

ok.description: True when the request succeeded, including when the answer is an empty list. False for a missing or rejected key, a plan that does not include this data, an unknown id, a rate limit or a network error. The message then says what to do. check_api_status is the exception: it is true whenever the API answered, and reports API key problems in the message.

category.description: Tournament category (grand_slam, masters_1000, tour_finals, atp_500, atp_250, wta_1000, wta_500, wta_250, wta_125, challenger, itf, juniors). Set only where the category is unambiguous. Null otherwise, never derived from the name.

city.description: Host city, from a curated table. Null where not curated.

country.description: Host country, ISO-3166 alpha-2. Null where not curated.

id.description: Stable tournament id, the same id match objects carry as tournament_id.

surface.description: Court surface: hard, clay or grass.

tour.description: atp, wta, challenger, itf or juniors.

title: Tournament catalogue
